phases.name: Supernova
phases.say: (It brightens until it is the only thing anyone can see.)

say.open: (A star has come down out of the dark, and it has made up its mind about you.)
say.death: (It goes out like a wish someone gave up on.)

bestiary.lore: The card of hope, from the far side of the rift: a fallen star that will not go back up, and will not be argued with.
bestiary.weakness: Dark. It is quick and small: pin it down before it wishes itself whole.
bestiary.pattern: Every third turn a starfall on four rows; cold light on a row's Sanity and blinding twinkles on the Back; it wishes itself hidden and healing when hurt. At Supernova the starfall comes every other turn.
